description:
Dimensions(approx.): 50 x IRR
Approximate Upset: $650,000.00, plus any additional advances, interests, sheriff's costs and commission to the date of sale
Occupancy status: Unknown
Amount due for taxes: As of July 10, 2025, the third quarter taxes for the tax year 2025 are due and owing in the amount of $Undetermined; There is also due and owing an outstanding tax sale certificate, number 23-0008, in the original amount of $25,735.77, plus subsequent taxes, interest and charges.
The sale is subject to any unpaid taxes and assessments, tax, water and sewer liens and other municipal assessments. The amount due can be obtained from the local taxing authority.
All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereof. **If the sale is set aside for any reason, the purchaser at the sale may be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The purchaser shall have no further recourse against of the mortgagor, mortgagee or the mortgagee's attorney.
As the above description does not constitute a full legal description, said the full legal description is annexed to that certain mortgage recorded in the Office of the Clerk of Passaic County in Book M18483 at Page 201, et seq., Paterson, New Jersey, and the Writ of Execution on the file with the Sheriff of Passaic County
